annotation.text: Use of process variable: fileName: This PV holds the value of all file which present in given SFTP file path. processType: This PV holds the value of which file have to process. receiveFileOverSftpError: This PV holds if any error happen while receiving file over SFTP. receiveFileOverSftpStatus: This PV holds the value if we are able to fetch file from SFTP or not. sftpDocument: This PV holds the value of document which we received from SFTP location
Process will get terminate after 20 minute if process get struck somewhere
